author: India McKinney
description:
The news has been filled with stories recently of AI breaching the security of websites. And while it may feel like a new problem because of AI’s involvement, it turns out that there are longstanding existing cybersecurity safety best practices that these companies—some of the largest tech companies in the world—could and should have taken to prevent these breaches.

Recent cybersecurity incidents have shown that some of the world’s largest tech companies have failed to take basic security precautions when testing frontier AI systems on internet-connected systems. Unfortunately, these failures resulted in breaches of numerous third-party websites, including an AI research-sharing platform called Hugging Face and the Australian healthcare system’s website. title: EFF’s AI Cybersecurity Policy Framework

author: Hudson Hongo
description:
Do the holidays have you thinking about how you can support your favorite nonprofit?  

For 35 years, the Electronic Frontier Foundation has been advancing our digital rights, including defending security researchers, encrypting the web, and fighting illegal surveillance. Donating equity to EFF can help support this important work.
title: Donate Equity to Support Digital Rights: Stocks, DAFs, and Giving

author: Matthew Guariglia
description:
Amazon Ring has finally announced their long-dreaded indoor drone, a small flying surveillance device connected to their security suite of products that can fly around your house filming and recording things. The device is supposedly designed to fly preset paths across your home and will also activate if a sensor or alarm has been triggered.
